findings.claim: The assigned segment 0:00 to 6:43 includes the creator chapters flex-wrap (3:12) and align-content (3:36), which the page does not teach and no objective names. The caution only flags align-self and order after the cut point, so a beginner is not told that wrap and align-content inside the segment are also beyond this topic and will not be tested.
findings.recommendation: Extend the caution: 'flex-wrap and align-content (3:12 to 4:08) are extra; the page does not use them. align-self and order after 6:43 are beyond this topic.' Alternatively note that 4:08 to 4:20 (gap) is the part of that range that matters for o2.
